rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are called those brought near, not those who draw near: God's drawing them near precedes their own effort, the mark of the station of union.
rows.anchor: لم يقل : { المتقربون } بل قال : أولئك المقربون - وهذاعين الجمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Garden of Bliss means paradise.
rows.anchor: { فى جنات النعيم } . أي : في الجنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their nearness is honor, not spatial distance: selves near paradise, hearts near the Real and gnosis, and spirits in witnessing; God transcends nearness, distance, separation, and union.
rows.anchor: مقربة نفوسهم من الجنة وقلوبهم إلى الحق . مقربة قلوبهم من بساط المعرفة ، وأرواحهم من ساحات الشهود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading is that they are brought near in their allotments, shares, and states, though the Real remains beyond even their purified states.
rows.anchor: ويقال : مقربون ولكن من حظوظهم ونصيبهم . وأحوالهم - وإن صفت - فالحق وراء الوراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One explanation takes the many early ones as those who witnessed their prophets and the few later ones as those who witnessed Muhammad.
rows.anchor: ويقال : ثلة من الأولين الذين شاهدوا أنبياءهم وقليل من الآخرين الذين شاهدوا نبينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another explanation identifies the early ones as the predecessors and the few later ones as later members of the community.
rows.anchor: ويقال : ثلة من الاولين : من السلف وقليل من المتأخرين : من الأمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The woven couches are made with gold in a weave like chain mail.
rows.anchor: أي منسوخة نسيج الدرع من الذهب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A transmitted description makes each couch three hundred cubits long; it lowers when its occupant wants to sit in humility and rises when he settles on it.
rows.anchor: جاء في التفسير : طول كل سرير ثلاثمائة ذراع ، إن أراد الجلوس عليه تواضع ، وإن استوى عليه ارتفع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They face one another so none sees another's back, reflecting pure affection and refined character.
rows.anchor: أي لا يرى بعضهم قفا بعض . وصفهم بصفاء المودة وتهذب الأخلاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The serving boys remain in one age, never growing old, while the people of paradise remain in place.
rows.anchor: يطوف عليهم وهم مقيمون لا يبرحون ولدان في سن واحدة . . . لا يهرمون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An alternative gloss says the boys wear earrings, taking khildah to mean an earring.
rows.anchor: وقيل : مقرطون ( الخلدة . القرط )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A cup (kūb) has neither handle nor spout; an ewer (ibrīq) has both.
rows.anchor: آنية بلا عروة ولا خرطوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their drink causes neither headache nor loss of reason.
rows.anchor: شربهم إياها ، كما لا تذهب عقولهم بسببها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They receive fruits they choose, bird meat they desire, and protected houris like hidden pearls as recompense for their deeds.
rows.anchor: ولهم كذلك فاكهة مما يتخيرون ، ولحم طير مما يشتهون ، وحور عين ، كأمثال اللؤلؤ المكنون ، أي : المصون ، جزاء بما كانوا يعملون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laghw is false speech; ta'thīm is sin and delirious talk.
rows.anchor: اللغو : الباطل من القول ، والتأثيم : الإثم والهذيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the phrase 'a saying: peace,' salāman is an adjective describing the saying.
rows.anchor: وسلاما : نعت للقيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The right-hand people are among thornless lote trees and stacked talh trees, identified here as banana trees.
rows.anchor: شجر الموز ، متراكم نضيد بعضه على بعض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The extended shade lasts from daybreak until sunrise.
rows.anchor: كما بين الإسفار إلى طلوع الشمس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering the divine name requires a noble tongue that does not change in absence and is not used for mentioning others; knowing it requires an undivided, noble heart.
rows.anchor: كلمة عزيزة من ذكرها يحتاج إلى لسان عزيز في الغيبة لا يتبدل ، وفي ذكر الأغيار لا يستعمل

words: يسبح لله ما فى السماوات وما فى الأرض
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All creatures praise God, but people made deaf by denial cannot hear their glorification; acquired deafness may be cured, unlike congenital deafness.
rows.anchor: المخلوقات كلها بجملتها لله سبحانه مسبحة . . ولكن لا يسمع تسبيحها من به طرش النكرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God named each person in His prior decree, knew and willed who would disbelieve or believe, and created each in that state.
rows.anchor: منكم كافر في سابق حكمه سماه كافرا ، وعلم أنه يكفر وأراد به الكفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creating the heavens and earth in truth means that God acts rightly in His creation.
rows.anchor: أي وهو محق في خلقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse uniquely praises human outward and inward forms: the outward witnesses God's power, and the inward His majestic nearness.
rows.anchor: صور الظاهر وصور الباطن ؛ فالظاهر شاهد على كمال قدرته ، والباطن شاهد على جلال قربته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human knowledge and power fall short of what is sought, so people should ask God, who knows their need and can fulfill it.
rows.anchor: قصروا حيلكم عن مطلوبكم ، فهو تتقاصر عنه علومكم ، وأنا أعلم ذلك دونكم . . فاطلبوا مني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's knowledge of secrets warns against subtle ostentation and hidden faults, commanding watchfulness between servant and Lord.
rows.anchor: أمر بالمراقبة بين العبد وربه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's knowledge of what people display warns them not to let outward behavior contradict inward conviction and commands honest dealings and self-accounting with others.
rows.anchor: أمر بالصدق في المعاملة والمحاسبة مع الخلق

words: ألم يأتكم نبؤا الذين كفروا من قبل
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earlier unbelievers are a warning: whoever fails to learn stumbles into wishful hopes and recovers only after the chance has passed.
rows.anchor: المراد من ذلك هو الاعتبار بمن سلف ، ومن لم يعتبر عثر في مهواة من الامل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They viewed guidance only from the human, created side and fell into confusion; seeing through reality would free them from false multiplicity and changing conditions by witnessing God's decree.
rows.anchor: شاهدوا الأمر من حيث الخلق فتطوحوا في متاهات الإشكال المختلفة الأحوال . ولو نظروا بعين الحقيقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is death of the self and death of the heart: resurrection revives the dead self, but many sincere Sufis say there is no revival from heart-death until gnosis becomes necessary.
rows.anchor: الموت نوعان : موت نفس ، وموت قلب ، ففي القيامة يبعثون من موت النفس ، وأما موت القلب فلا بعث منه - عند كثير من مخلصي هذه الطائفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those whose hearts are dead will cry out at resurrection; had they known God, they would not ask who raised them, and their heart-death persists now.
rows.anchor: فلو عرفوه لما قالوا ذلك ؛ فموت قلوبهم مسرمد إلى أن تصير معارفهم ضرورية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The light sent down is the Qur'an.
rows.anchor: { النور الذي أنزلنا } : القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the light is tranquility and varieties of gracious gifts placed in God's friends' hearts.
rows.anchor: ويجوز ان يكون ما أنزل في قلوب اوليائه من السكينة وفنون الألطاف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The obedient regrets not doing more, while the sinner regrets accumulating lapses; the deeper loss concerns spiritual states, not just degrees.
rows.anchor: المطيع - يومئذ - في غبن لأنه لم يستكثر من الطاعة ، والعاصي في غبن لأنه استكثر من الزلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every event is created by God and governed by His knowledge and will; faith guides the heart to God through ease and adversity now, and to paradise in the next life.
rows.anchor: أي حصلة حصلت فمن قبله خلقا ، وبعلمه وإرادته حكما . { يهد قلبه } حتى يهتدي إلى الله في السراء والضراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The guided heart may be directed toward noble character and freedom from the soul's avarice.
rows.anchor: ويقال : { يهد قلبه } للأخلاق السنية ، والتنقي من شح النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading is guidance to follow the Sunna and avoid innovation.
rows.anchor: ويقال : { يهد قلبه } لاتباع السنة واجتناب البدعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Obedience to God and His messengers is obligatory because the messengers are envoys between God and creation.
rows.anchor: طاعة الله واجبة ، وطاعة الرسل - الذين هم سفراء بينه وبين الخلق - واجبة كذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spiritual lights that appear to a person and demand their due are true and from the Real, so they too must be obeyed.
rows.anchor: والأنوار التي تظهر عليك وتطالب بمقتضياتها كلها حق ، ومن الحق . . فتجب طاعتها أيضا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Family members are enemies when they urge one to accumulate worldly goods; they are not enemies when wealth is taken lawfully and with restraint.
rows.anchor: إذا دعوك لتجمع لهم الدنيا فهم عدو لك ، أما إذا أخذتم منها على وجه العفاف فليسوا لكم أعداء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wealth and children are a trial when they distract people from God's due; what one gathers while turning from God is inauspicious.
rows.anchor: يشغلونك عن أداء حق الله ؛ فما تبق عن الله مشغولا بجمعه فهو غير ميمون عليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Accumulating for other than God and becoming absorbed in children's reform diverts one from obedience and may corrupt both parent and child.
rows.anchor: إذا جمعتم الدنيا لغير وجهه فإنكم تشغلون بذلك عن أداء حق مولاكم ، وتشغلكم أولادكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to fear God applies while a person remains generally capable and subject to religious obligation.
rows.anchor: أي ما دمتم في الجملة مستطيعين ويتوجه عليكم التكليف فاتقوا لله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The utmost taqwa is to witness that one's own taqwa falls short, while leaving no deficiency in one's practice of it.
rows.anchor: والتقوى عن شهود التقوى بعد إلا يكون تقصير في التقوى غاية التقوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The successful are freed from self-avarice, dangers in the heart, and enslavement to created things.
rows.anchor: حتى ترتفع الاخطار عن قلبه ، ويتحرر من رق المكونات ، { فأولئك هم المفلحون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to lend God a good loan addresses the wealthy as a call to give their property.
rows.anchor: يتوجه بهذا الخطاب إلى الأغنياء ببذل أموالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the poor, the loan means emptying their days and time of personal desires and preferring God's will in self, heart, and time.
rows.anchor: وللفقراء في إخلاء أيامهم وأوقاتهم من مراداتهم وإيثار مراد الحق على مراد أنفسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God caused the Prophet to forget his wives and withdraw; estrangement, threatened divorce of Hafsa, reconciliation, and twenty-nine nights without relations with Mariya expressed divine jealousy and turned their hearts back to God.
rows.anchor: وقد ألقى الله في قلب رسوله تناسيا بينه وبين زوجاته فاعتزلهن ، وما كان من حديث طلاق حفصة ، وما عاد إلى قلب أبيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse rebukes Aisha and Hafsa for an inward movement against the Prophet and declares God, Gabriel, righteous believers, and angels his protectors.
rows.anchor: عاتبهما على السير من خطرات القلب ، ثم قال : { وإن تظاهرا عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The righteous believers are those without hypocrisy in their hearts, such as Abu Bakr and Umar.
rows.anchor: وصالح المؤمنين } من لم يكن منهم في قلبه نفاق ، مثل أبي بكر وعمر

rows.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
rows.claim: When Umar heard something of the affair, he told the Prophet that he would behead her if ordered.
rows.anchor: أن عمر بن الخطاب لما سمع شيئا من ذلك قال لرسول الله : لو أمرتني لأضربن عنقها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rebuke concerns Aisha and Hafsa speaking about Mariya.
rows.anchor: والعتاب في الآية مع عائشة وحفصة رضى الله عنهما إذ تكلمتا في أمر مارية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Protecting one's family means teaching understanding, disciplining them, calling them to obedience, and guiding them so they do not deserve punishment; this establishes enjoining right with nearest kin first.
rows.anchor: فقهوهم ، وأدبوهم ، وادعوهم إلى طاعة الله ، وامنعوهم عن استحقاق العقوبة بإرشادهم وتعليمهم . ودلت الآية : على وجوب الأمر بالمعروف في الدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One application is to model worship so family members learn it and make it their habit.
rows.anchor: وقيل : أظهرا من أنفسكم العبادات ليتعلموا منكم ، ويعتادوا كعادتكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another application is to direct one's family to the Sunna and community.
rows.anchor: ويقال : دلوهم على السنة والجماعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another application is to teach them good character.
rows.anchor: ويقال : علموهم الأخلاق الحسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another application is to command them to accept sincere advice.
rows.anchor: ويقال : مروهم بقبول النصيحة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Waqūd means firewood.
rows.anchor: الوقود : الحطب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A wordplay says human affairs may be set right by a stone or clod because humans originate from earth; the author prays to be made a stone instead and saved from the Fire.
rows.anchor: أمر الناس يصلح بحجرة أومدرة ، فإن أصل الإنسان مدرة ، ولو أنه أقام حجرة مقام مدرة فلا غرو من فضل الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once time has passed, the matter becomes grave, the door closes, and excuses fail; therefore one must hasten to flee toward repose.
rows.anchor: إذا فات الوقت استفحل الأمر ، وانغلق الباب ، وسقطت الحيل . . . . فالواجب البدار والفرار لتصل إلى روح القرار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sincere repentance is repentance that is never followed by a return to sin.
rows.anchor: التوبة النصوح : هي التي لا يعقبها نقض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another definition is not to credit oneself with repentance or salvation through it, but to see both as coming from the Lord.
rows.anchor: هي التي لا تراها من نفسك ، ولا تبى نجاتك بها ، وإنما تراها بربك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another definition is to feel the bitterness of remembering a lapse that one once found pleasurable to commit.
rows.anchor: هي أن تجد المرارة في قلبك عند ذكر الزلة كما كنت تجد الراحة لنفسك عند فعلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not disgrace the Prophet by withholding intercession or believers by exposing them after accepting his intercession; their moving light signifies faith surrounding them on every side.
rows.anchor: لا يخزي الله النبي بترك شفاعته ، والذين آمنوا معه بافتضاحهم بعد ما قبل فيهم شفاعته . { نورهم يسعى بين أيديهم وبأيمانهم } عبر بذلك عن أن الإيمان من جميع جهاتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the light in their right hands is the book of salvation, and their lights include unity, gnosis, faith, and gifts specific to that day.
rows.anchor: بأيمانهم كتاب نجاتهم : أراد نور توحيدهم ونور معرفتهم ونور إيمانهم ، وما يخصهم الله به من الأنوار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their request to perfect their light is a continuing practice of humble supplication and earnest prayer.
rows.anchor: يستديمون التضرع والابتهال في السؤال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet was first told to be gentle in invitation (16:125), then to be severe after opponents persisted despite proof and their excuses ended.
rows.anchor: أمره بالملاينة في وقت الدعوة ، وقال : { وجادلهم بالتى هى أحسن } [ النحل : 125 ] ثم لما أصروا - بعد بيان الحجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their separation had been decreed at the allotment, so marital closeness could not help Noah's and Lot's wives on the day of punishment.
rows.anchor: لما سبقت لهما الفرقة يوم القسمة لم تنفعهما القربة يوم العقوبة

words: رب ابن لى عندك بيتا فى الجنة
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some fault Asiya for asking only for a house in paradise, saying her ambition was small; Qushayri rejects this criticism.
rows.anchor: قالوا : صغرت همتها حيث طلبت بيتا في الجنة ، وكان من حقها أن تطلب الكثير . . . ولا كما توهموا

words: رب ابن لى عندك بيتا فى الجنة
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By asking for a house 'with You,' Pharaoh's wife sought nearness and honor in God's presence; a house in that company is better than a thousand elsewhere.
rows.anchor: فإنها قالت : { رب ابن لى عندك } فطلبت جوار القربة ، ولبيت في الجوار أفضل من ألف قصر في غير الجوار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here 'with You' means nearness and honor, while the requested house still has a special distinction over other dwellings.
rows.anchor: العندية القربة والكرامة . . ولكنه على كل حال بيت له مزية على غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A couplet celebrates the value of being God's neighbor, wishing to buy even a span of a neighbor's house at great cost.
rows.anchor: إني لأحسد جاركم لجواركم . . . طوبى لمن أضحى لدارك جارا يا ليت جارك باعني من داره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sura closes by mentioning this woman after Pharaoh's wife; as it has spoken often of women, this honors her rank.
rows.anchor: ختم السورة بذكرها بعد ما ذكر امرأة فرعون ، وهما من جملة النساء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever witnesses God's gentleness does not abase himself before creatures or seek help from dependent beings; he thanks God for gifts and praises Him beautifully in deprivation.
rows.anchor: من شهد لطفه لم يتلل بعدع لمخلوق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation identifies Nūn as the whale bearing the cosmos on its back.
rows.anchor: قيل : الحوت الذي على ظهره الكون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes Nūn to mean an inkwell.
rows.anchor: ويقال : هي الدواة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another takes the letter as the key to divine names Nāṣir and Nūr.
rows.anchor: مفتاح اسمه ناصر واسمه نور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another explanation says the oath invokes God's support for His believing servants.
rows.anchor: أقسم بنصرة الله تعالى لعباده المؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The oath by the pen is answered by the assurance that Muhammad is not mad and has an undiminished reward.
rows.anchor: وأقسم بالقلم - وجواب القسم قوله : { مآ أنت بنعمة ربك بمجنون وإن لك لأجرا غير ممنون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God removes the Prophet's distress at the enemies' accusation of madness by emphatically denying it; God answers and refutes what enemies say about His Messenger.
rows.anchor: ما أوجب لصدره من الوحشة من قول الأعداء عنه : إنه مجنون ، أزاله عنه بنفيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An undiminished reward is a reward that is not reduced.
rows.anchor: { وإن لك لأجرا غير ممنون } : أي غير منقوص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although Muhammad's aspiration was too high to seek compensation, God promises him reward anyway; his great character includes freedom from expecting payment.
rows.anchor: لما سمت همته عن طلب الأعواض أثبت الله له الأجر ، فقال له : { وإن لك لأجرا غير ممنون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As God taught Muhammad the histories of earlier prophets, He informed him that their scattered virtues were all gathered in him.
rows.anchor: عرفه أنه اجتمعت فيه متفرقات أخلاقهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says he refused the keys of the earth and, on the night journey, saw the kingdom and paradise without looking toward them, as 53:17 says.
rows.anchor: إنه عرض مفاتيح الأرض فلم يقبلها ، ورقاه ليلة المعراج ، وأراه جميع المملكة والجنة فلم يلتفت إليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Neither adversity turns him away nor gifts divert him; he endured injury and prayed for his people, and while others will say 'myself,' he will plead for his community.
rows.anchor: لا بالبلاء تنحرف ، ولا بالعطاء تنصرف ؛ احتمل صلوات الله عليه في الأذى شج رأسه وثغره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad says 'my community, my community' when everyone else says 'myself, myself.'
rows.anchor: وغدا كل يقول : نفسي نفسي وهو صلوات الله عليه يقول : ( أمتي أمتي )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God taught him fine character through 7:199; Gabriel explained this as keeping ties with one who cuts them, giving to one who withholds, and forgiving one who wrongs.
rows.anchor: علمه محاسن الأخلاق بقوله : { خذ العفو وأمر بالمعرف وأعرض عن الجاهلين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Asked what his Lord commanded, Muhammad was told to embody fine character: keep ties with those who sever them, give to those who deny him, and pardon wrongdoers.
rows.anchor: بماذا يأمرني ربي ؟ قال : يأمرك بمحاسن الأخلاق ؛ يقول لك : صل من قطعك وأعط من حرمك واعف عمن ظلمك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The divine name delights poor hearts, gladdens the weak's inner secrets, comforts beloved spirits, strengthens God's friends, consoles the pure, and is joy to the afflicted.
rows.anchor: نزهة قلوب الفقراء ، كلمة سماعها بهجة أسرار الضعفاء ، راحة أرواح الأحباء ، قوة قولب الأولياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-mudaththir means the person wrapped in his garment.
rows.anchor: يا أيها المتدثر بثوبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This sura was among the first parts of the Qur'an to be revealed.
rows.anchor: وهذه السورة من أول ما أنزل من القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says Gabriel appeared in the air when Muhammad visited Hira before prophethood; he returned to Khadija asking to be covered, then Gabriel commanded him to rise and warn.
rows.anchor: قيل : إن رسول الله ذهب إلى حراء قبل النبوة ، فبدا له جبريل في الهواء ، فرجع الرسول إل بيت خديجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading tells the person seeking protection from harm through a cloak to seek it instead through warning others.
rows.anchor: أيها الطالب صرف الأذى عنك بالدثار اطلبه بالإنذار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another address calls him to rise with God, cast aside all else, warn God's servants, and take the highest station.
rows.anchor: قم بنا ، وأسقط عنك ما سوانا ، وأنذر عبادنا ؛ فلقد أقمناك بأشرف المواقف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When he obeyed 'rise,' he was cut off from repose and from tranquility even while standing.
rows.anchor: لما سكن إلى قوله { قم } وقام قطع عن السكون إلى قيامه ، ومن الطمانينة في قيامه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Magnify the Lord above every demand, connection or separation, cause, or created thing.
rows.anchor: كبره عن كل طلب ، ووصل وفصل ، وعلة وخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Purify the heart of creatures and blameworthy traits, the self of lapses, the heart of disobedience, and the secret of distracting glances.
rows.anchor: طهر قلبك عن الخلائق أجمع ، وعن كل صفة مذمومة . وطهر نفسك عن الزلات ، وقلبك عن المخالفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading is to purify one's family through exhortation; wives are called clothing in 2:187, so they can be described as garments.
rows.anchor: أهلك طهرهم بالوعظ ؛ قال تعالى : { هن لباس لكم } [ البقرة : 187 ]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rujz is glossed as sins; another gloss identifies it as Satan.
rows.anchor: أي : المعاصي . ويقال : الشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another application is to cleanse the heart of sins and worldly preoccupations.
rows.anchor: طهر قلبك من الخطايا وأشغال الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As an unhealthy body cannot enjoy food, an unsound heart cannot taste the sweetness of obedience.
rows.anchor: من لا يصح جسمه لا يجد شهوة الطعام كذلك من لا يصح قلبه لا يجد حلاوة الطاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not give in order to get more back than you gave.
rows.anchor: لا تعط عطاء تطلب به زيادة على ما تعطيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, do not regard obedience as abundant or boast in deeds and admire them.
rows.anchor: لا تستكثر الطاعة من نفسك . ويقال : لا تمنن بعملك فتستكثر عملك ، وتعجب به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since you suffer harm for God's sake, endure the opponents' abuse.
rows.anchor: أنت تؤذى في الله . فاصبر على مقاساة أذاهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the trumpet is sounded, the Resurrection comes; that day is difficult for unbelievers and not easy.
rows.anchor: يعني : إذا قامت القيامة ، فذلك يوم عسير على الكافرين غير هين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not concern yourself with their affair: God will take care of it, having created the person alone without a partner.
rows.anchor: لا تهتم بشأنهم ، ولاتحتفل ؛ فإني أكفيك أمرهم . إني خلقته وحدي ؛ لم يشاركني في خلقي إياه أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the person was created alone without a supporter.
rows.anchor: ويحتمل : خلقته وحده لا ناصر له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gave him abundant, extended wealth.
rows.anchor: وجعلت له مالا ممدودا وبنين شهودا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His sons are present with him and need not travel away.
rows.anchor: حضورا معه لا يحتاجون إلى السفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearing the divine name with the ear of ecstasy yields loyalty and forgetfulness of others; hearing through knowledge yields generosity; hearing through unity strips the heart of preference for anything else in both worlds.
rows.anchor: جاد له فلم يبخل بروحه على أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These states arise through the divine name and come from God alone.
rows.anchor: ومن سمعها بسمع التوحيد جرد سره عن إيثار ما سواه في الدنيا والعقبى عينا وأثرا فما كان هذا كله إلا حاصلا به كائنا منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-mursalāt are angels sent with recognized or good commands; alternatively, they are numerous like a horse's mane.
rows.anchor: الملائكة { عرفا } أي : أرسلوا بالمعروف من الأمر ، أو كثيرين كعرف الفرس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ʿāṣifāt are strong winds; ʿuṣūf brings chaff, the leaves and debris of crops.
rows.anchor: الرياح الشديدة ( العوصف تأتي بالعصف وهو ورق الزرع وحطامه )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-nāshirāt may be rains that spread plants, with nashr meaning revival; alternatively they are clouds spreading rain or angels.
rows.anchor: الأمطار ( لأنها تنشر النبات . فالنشر بمعنى الإحياء ) . ويقال السحب تنشر الغيث . ويقال : الملائكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The separating ones are angels, who distinguish lawful from unlawful.
rows.anchor: الملائكة ؛ تفرق بين الحلال والحرام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ones casting down a reminder are angels delivering revelation to prophets as a warning and a means to establish the case.
rows.anchor: الملائكة : تلقي الوحي على الأنبياء عليهم السلام ؛ إعذارا وإنذارا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The oath asserts that the promised Resurrection is true and will occur.
rows.anchor: فأقسم بهذه الأشياء : إن القيامة لحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The stars' light will disappear when they are blotted out at the Resurrection.
rows.anchor: و { طمست } : ذهب ضوؤها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mountains will be swept away rapidly until no trace remains.
rows.anchor: ذهب بها كلها بسرعة ، حتى لا يبقى لها أثر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The messengers are given a fixed time for judgment on the Day of Decision; alternatively, they were sent at appointed times.
rows.anchor: جعل لها وقتا وأجلا لفصل القضاء يوم القيامة . ويقال : أرسلت لأوقات معلومة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question magnifies the Day of Decision.
rows.anchor: على جهة التعظيم له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The meaning of 'woe' has already been explained.
rows.anchor: مضى تفسير معنى الويل . ويقال في الإشارات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In an inward reading, the stars are lights of gnosis extinguished by the onset of absence from witnessing.
rows.anchor: فإذا نجوم المعارف طمست بوقوع الغيبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The still mountains of hearts grounded in witnessing are shaken as punishment for aspiring to what is forbidden; woe falls on false claimants with sealed hearts empty of spiritual meanings.
rows.anchor: القلوب الساكنة بيقين الشهود حركت عقوبة على ما همت بالذي لا يجوز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God destroyed earlier peoples who denied messengers and signs and will likewise punish later criminals if they repeat their deeds.
rows.anchor: الذين كذبوا رسلهم ، وجحدوا آياتنا ؛ فمثلما أهلكنا الأولين كذلك نفعل بالمجرمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The deniers include people whose outward appearance and inward state do not agree in faith.
rows.anchor: الذين لا يستوي ظاهرهم وباطنهم في التصديق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Earlier wayfarers who lapsed, fell short in the path, and betrayed love's obligations suffered deprivation in this life and tasted none of its spiritual meanings.
rows.anchor: أهل الزلة والفترة في الطريقة ، والخيانة في أحكام المحبة فعذبوا بالحرمان في عاجلهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The contemptible origin of human beings should lead them to infer resurrection from their first creation.
rows.anchor: وإذ قد علمتم ذلك فلم لم تقيسوا أمر البعث عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reminding humans of their humble origin restrains conceit about their states, since no creatures claim more than Adam's descendants.
rows.anchor: ذكرهم أصل خلقتم لئلا يعجبوا بأحوالهم ؛ فإنه لا جنس من المخلوقين والمخلوقات أشد دعوى من بني آدم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The story recalls Moses' call in the sacred valley Ṭuwā, a purified and blessed land; Ṭuwā is the valley's name.
rows.anchor: أي الأرض المطهرة المباركة . { طوى } اسم الوادي هناك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses is told to go to Pharaoh because he transgressed and invite him to believe and cleanse himself of sins.
rows.anchor: قلنا له : { اذهب إلى فرعون إنه طغى } ، فقل له : هل يقع لك أن تؤمن وتتطهر من ذنوبك

words: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An interpretation promises that saying 'There is no god but God' brings an imperishable kingdom, unaging youth, four hundred years of joy and comfort, and then paradise.
rows.anchor: لو قلت لا إله إلا الله فلك ملك لا يزول ، وشبابك لا يهرم ، وتعيش أربعمائة سنة في السرورة والنعمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses offers to establish the truth of his message through signs and make Pharaoh know the truth of the religion, asking whether he wants this guidance.
rows.anchor: أقرر لك بالآيات صحة ما أقول ، وأعرفك صحة الدين . . فهل لك ذلك ؟

words: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although Moses spoke with utmost gentleness, God's hidden decree turned Pharaoh's heart away, planted refusal, and prevented him from accepting counsel.
rows.anchor: أظهر له كل هذا التلطف ولكنه في خفي سره وواجب مكره به أنه صرف قلبه عن إرداة هذه الأشياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The great sign was Moses' hand emerging white and shining like the sun; Pharaoh consulted Haman, who warned that he would lose his lordship and kingship if he became subject.
rows.anchor: هي إخراج يده بيضاء لها شعاع كشعاع الشمس . فقال فرعون : حتى أشاور هامان ، فشاوره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Following Haman's counsel, Pharaoh denied the message, disobeyed, gathered the magicians, and proclaimed himself the highest lord.
rows.anchor: فكذب فرعون عند ذلك ، وعصى ، وجمع السحرة ، ونادى : { فقال أنا ربكم الأعلى }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblis fled on hearing Pharaoh's claim, saying he could not bear it: he had claimed superiority over Adam and suffered for it, while Pharaoh claimed to be the highest lord.
rows.anchor: إن إبليس لما سمع هذا الخطاب فر وقال : لا أطيق هذا ! ويقال : قال : أنا ادعيت الخيرية على آدم فلقيت ما لقيت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh's destruction is a lesson for anyone who fears God.
rows.anchor: أي في إهلاكنا فرعون لعبرة لمن يخشى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God raised and shaped the heaven's roof evenly.
rows.anchor: { فسواها } جعلها مستوية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He made the night dark and brought out the daylight and its brightness.
rows.anchor: { وأغطش ليلها } أظلم ليلها . { ضحاها } ضوؤها ونهارها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He spread the earth and brought forth its flowing springs and vegetation.
rows.anchor: { دحاهآ } بسطها ومدها . { أخرج منها مآءها ومرعاها } . أخرج من الأرض العيون المتفجرة بالماء ، وأخرج النبات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God fixed the mountains as pegs for the earth.
rows.anchor: أثبتها أوتادا للأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The vegetation is provided for people and their livestock to enjoy.
rows.anchor: أي أخرجنا النبات ليكون لكم به استمتاع ، وكذلك لأنعامكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The greatest calamity is the overwhelming catastrophe of Resurrection.
rows.anchor: الداهية العظمى . . وهي القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: That day people remember their deeds and Hell is exposed; the transgressor who disbelieved and preferred worldly life will dwell there.
rows.anchor: وبرزت الجحيم لمن يرى ، فأما من طغى وكفر وآثر الحياة الدنيا فإن الجحيم له المأوى والمستقر والمثوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lord's station means either standing before Him at tomorrow's judgment or God's turning toward and seeing the servant; the latter is watchfulness, while the former is accounting.
rows.anchor: وقوفه غدا في محل الحساب . ويقال : إقبال الله عليه وأنه راء له . . وهذا عين المراقبة ، والآخر محل المحاسبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person restrains the self by not following its desires.
rows.anchor: أي لم يتابع هواه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ask when the Hour will occur, but the Prophet was not given its knowledge; its timing belongs to God alone.
rows.anchor: أي متى تقوم ؟ { فيم أنت من ذكراها } . من أين لك علمها ولم نعلمك ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is a warner, and those who fear the Hour are the ones who accept his warning and believe.
rows.anchor: أي تخوف ، فيقبل تخويفك من يخشاها ويؤمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When people see the Resurrection, their long stay beneath the earth will seem like an evening or morning because of its terror.
rows.anchor: فلشدة ما يرون تقل عندهم كثرة ما لبثوا تحت الأرض
